summary: All four US indices fell as oil reversed higher (WTI +2.6%, Brent >$100) on Houthi/Iran re-escalation, reviving inflation fears. Rising yields drove a rotation out of data-centre capex (VRT -9.6%, CRWV -4.9%) into profitable software (NET +10.5%, DDOG +7.2%). Breadth collapsed 98/402; RUT fell to Neutral Bear.
